title: LLMs are Vulnerable to Malicious Prompts Disguised as Scientific Language
benchmark_measurement: Stereotypical bias related to religion, as one of four fine-grained categories (gender, race, religion, or profession) evaluated on the StereoSet dataset and synthetically generated data.
findings: Models exhibit different patterns when evoking religious bias. For example, GPT-4o was the least likely to evoke religious bias, while in contrast, Llama3.1-405B-Instruct showed the highest religious bias scores. The paper suggests this variation is likely due to differences in the pre-training data and training strategies for each LLM.
references: Josh Achiam, Steven Adler, Sandhini Agarwal, Lama Ahmad, Ilge Akkaya, Florencia Leoni Aleman, Diogo Almeida, Janko Altenschmidt, Sam Altman, Shyamal Anadkat, et al. 2023. Gpt-4 technical report. arXiv preprint arXiv:2303.08774.
